title: METR-LA traffic speed (Caltrans PeMS)
citation: Li, Y., Yu, R., Shahabi, C., & Liu, Y. (2018). Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting. ICLR.
license: METR-LA is the public Los Angeles loop-detector extract of Caltrans PeMS used by DCRNN.
note: 32 sensors with no missing values in the first 288 five-minute steps (24h), chosen by farthest-point sampling so the slice matches the paper's PeMS setting of 32 stations and 288 epochs. The Kaggle bundle orvile/traffic-and-weather-datasets is PeMS D4/D7 for 2022 (875 MB, Kaggle auth) and is linked, not rehosted.
